thread:
maya: Heads up — after last night's IdP metadata refresh the SCIM backfill for new hires is failing. Getting KMS decrypt/encrypt errors when we try to write audit logs. Anyone seen this pattern?

ops-bot: deploybot: SAML metadata refresh completed for idp-redwood-prod (s3://idp-metadata/2025-11-02.xml)

lee: saw the errors in logs, pasting a snippet:
```
2025-11-02T03:22:11Z scim-service ERROR backfill user=ajones status=500 err=\"KMSDecrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Encrypt\"
2025-11-02T03:22:11Z audit-writer ERROR audit write failed user=ajones err=\"AccessDenied: not authorized to encrypt with key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01\"
```

jordan: can you share the metadata URL and cert thumbprint? wondering if cert rotation changed the NameID mapping or entityID so our SCIM mapping broke too

maya: metadata: https://idp.example.com/metadata.xml
snippet shows new X509Certificate block changed (fingerprint != previous)

samir: I rotated the signing cert/key last night and uploaded metadata to S3. I also created a new KMS key for audit-logs (audit-kms-v2) and tried to update the key policy, but I might've missed the SCIM service role ARN. investigating now.

maya: logs show the exact AWS error when SCIM tries to write audit: 
```
aws-kms:Encrypt error: AccessDeniedException: User: arn:aws:sts::123456789012:assumed-role/scim-service-role/session is not authorized to perform: kms:Encrypt on resource arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01
```

talha: likely key policy missing scim-role. Also check IAM role permissions and resource-based policy on the key. Run:
`aws kms get-key-policy --key-id arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-ef01`
`aws sts get-caller-identity`
and verify the role ARN matches.

k8s-deploy-bot: rollout restart deployment/scim-service namespace=prod triggered by samir

lee: temporary workaround possible: point SCIM audit writer at the old audit-kms (audit-kms-v1) while policy is fixed, then requeue backfill. Not ideal but unblocks onboarding.

samir: confirmed — key policy for audit-kms-v2 omitted `arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/scim-service-role` because of a bad env var in my terraform. Pushing a fix now to attach the role to the key policy and add kms:Encrypt/kms:Decrypt permissions.

jordan: another related thing — after cert rotation the SAML Assertion NameID format changed from `urn:oasis:names:tc:SAML:1.1:nameid-format:emailAddress` to `persistent`. That caused our SCIM->RBAC pipeline to not map email to principal, so even when users were created they weren't assigned product roles. We need a fallback mapping (externalId -> email) in the provisioner.

maya: that explains the missing roles. Can we add a migration/fallback to map NameID/persistent to email using the `urn:oid:0.9.2342.19200300.100.1.3` attribute when available?

talha: I'll open a quick PR to add the fallback and add an alert on KMS AccessDenied metric (CloudWatch alarm). Also will add a README note about key policy and scim-role.

ops-bot: incident-tracker: IS-2025-2337 created by maya - \"SCIM backfill failing with KMS AccessDenied after IdP metadata/cert rotation\"

samir: patched key policy and redeployed. Verified via AWS CLI as the scim-role: `aws kms decrypt --ciphertext-blob fileb://blob --key-id arn:aws:kms:...` returns success.

lee: requeued backfill job, processed ~3k users so far, audit writes succeed, no more KMS errors. :tada:

maya: thanks all. follow-ups:
- talha to merge RBAC fallback PR and add CloudWatch alarm
- samir to add checklist step for KMS key policy when rotating certs/keys
- ops to run a targeted audit to ensure no missed RBAC assignments

maya: closing loop once audit complete. Appreciate the quick turnaround.
